    • listenForMessages

      public void listenForMessages()
      listens for messages from server if the message starts with "*" it means it is a message for the game, not a text message - can receive message for resetting the board - can receive message for playing from a certain move - can receive message for playing from a new game state - can receive message for promoting - can receive message for a regular move

    • cleanup

      public void cleanup()
      closes the connection to the server and exits the program

    • sendMoves

      public void sendMoves()
      sends messages to the other client when a move is made continuously checks if a move was made - if it is a regular move, it immediately sends the move - if it is a promotion, it waits for the promotion to finish, then sends the move and which type of piece was promoted to

    • sendMove

      public void sendMove(String move)
      Parameters:
      move - - string for the move to send sends a single move to the other client (used when loading games to automatically send moves instead waiting for a player to make a move)

    • sendReset

      public void sendReset()
      sends a message to the other client to reset the board

    • sendPlayFromHere

      public void sendPlayFromHere(int move)
      Parameters:
      move - - the move number to play from sends a message to the other client to restart play from a certain move

    • sendGameState

      public void sendGameState(String pieces)
      Parameters:
      pieces - - a string of the position of all of the pieces ( same information as in the game state text file) sends a message to the other client for a new game state that includes all of the positions and conditions of the pieces on the board
